title: Tiny, cute cheese wedge
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0.35'/>

    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='42' ry='30' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <path d='M22 68 L22 40 L66 30 L66 55 Z' fill='#e8a72a'/>
  <!-- top face -->
  <path d='M22 40 L66 30 L80 42 L38 54 Z' fill='#ffd84d'/>
  <!-- front face -->
  <path d='M22 40 L38 54 L38 76 L22 68 Z' fill='#f7c22e'/>

  <path d='M38 54 L80 42 L80 64 L38 76 Z' fill='#ffcf3f'/>

  <path d='M22 40 L38 54 L80 42' fill='none' stroke='#fff0a8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='52' cy='56' rx='5' ry='3.6' fill='#d99420'/>

  <ellipse cx='56' cy='40' rx='2.4' ry='1.6' fill='#e0a11e'/>
  <!-- side face hole -->
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='52' rx='2.6' ry='3.4' fill='#d99420'/>
  <!-- cute face -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='55' rx='2.6' ry='2.6' fill='#5a2e00'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='52' rx='2.6' ry='2.6' fill='#5a2e00'/>
